claim: Make web CI run the standard TypeScript-aware build and lint as well as tests; a Vite-only bundle or passing unit tests does not establish type or lint correctness.

decisions.notes: The Orama #534 local follow-up found three TypeScript failures and mixed React Fast Refresh exports despite 248 passing tests. Type checks, lint, and all 248 tests passed together after repair.
